description: This file declares functions related to an auto-commit manager in a networking or device management context, specific to the wld module. It contains function prototypes for notifications, initialization, and destruction related to radio, access point, and endpoint edits.

methods.name: wld_autoCommitMgr_notifyRadEdit
methods.description: Notify that the radio has been edited.

methods.name: wld_autoCommitMgr_notifyVapEdit
methods.description: Notify that a VAP (Virtual Access Point) has been edited.

methods.name: wld_autoCommitMgr_notifyEpEdit
methods.description: Notify that an endpoint has been edited.

methods.name: wld_autoCommitMgr_init
methods.description: Initialize the auto-commit manager with a radio object.

methods.name: wld_autoCommitMgr_destroy
methods.description: Destroy and clean up the auto-commit manager with a radio object.
